description: Edits one cell of a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb). edit_mode "replace" (default) swaps the cell's source, "insert" adds a new cell after the cell with cell_id (or at the top when cell_id is omitted), "delete" removes the cell. The notebook must have been Read in this conversation first. Cells are identified by their id as shown by Read, or "cell-<n>" (0-based).

cell_id.description: Id of the cell to edit; for insert, the new cell goes after it.

new_source.description: The new source of the cell (not needed for delete).

notebook_path.description: Absolute or cwd-relative path to the .ipynb file.

name: NotebookEdit
